text:
emma: Quick sync on the rerank export modal — want to finalize microcopy and a11y before I push the prototype. Main questions: default format (CSV vs JSONL), whether to include a \"query snapshot\" by default, and how we communicate pagination/selection scope.

jon: I vote JSONL as default for rerank outputs. Keeps nested fields (scores, provenance) intact. CSV is fine for simple vector dumps but loses structure. :white_check_mark:

reza: JSONL makes sense for rerank pipelines. But CSV is still common for analysts. Maybe default JSONL but show a clear one-line helper: \"Need CSV? Select CSV — complex fields will be flattened.\"

abby: Copy for the query toggle: \"Include query snapshot (recommended)\" with caption: \"Stores the user query used to produce scores for reproducibility and audits. Not required for raw exports.\" Tooltip link to docs. Tooltip must be reachable via keyboard.

emma: Good. For filename pattern: `workspace-rerank-YYYYMMDD_HHMM.jsonl` and append `_with-query` when snapshot included. Keeps integrations deterministic.

jon: a11y bits: the toggle should have aria-pressed or role=switch and an aria-describedby id for the caption explaining compliance reasons. Also when user toggles, send an announcement via aria-live: \"Query snapshot included\" or \"Query snapshot excluded\".

reza: selection nuance: if user used \"select all matching\", we need the modal to show: \"Exporting X items (includes results not visible on this page)\" and clarify if sampling applied. If sample rate <1, show final count after sampling in bold.

abby: Analytics: aria-bot suggested event: `export_rerank_initiated` with props: format, include_query_snapshot, selection_scope, sample_rate, include_provenance. Also fire `export_rerank_completed` with filesize.

aria-bot: (automation) Confirmed: add events: [\"export_rerank_initiated\", \"export_rerank_completed\", \"export_rerank_failed\"] with attributes as mentioned.

emma: Visual layout: put format selector (JSONL/CSV) first, then the query snapshot toggle, then a small readout of selection scope + count. Primary CTA: \"Download Export\" (not ambiguous). Secondary: \"Copy link\" for S3 sharable link.

jon: small copy nudge: CTA aria-label should include file format & snapshot state, e.g., \"Download export as JSONL including query snapshot\". That helps screen reader users know what they'll get.

reza: backend contract snippet I drafted for engineers:\n```json
{
  \"selection\": \"explicit|all_matching\",
  \"format\": \"jsonl|csv\",
  \"include_query_snapshot\": true,
  \"include_provenance\": true,
  \"sample_rate\": 1.0
}
```
Drop this into the endpoint docs.

abby: accessibility checklist for the PR:
- focus order follows visual order
- format selector is a grouped radio with legend
- toggle uses role=switch + keyboard operable
- aria-live announcements for selection counts and toggle changes
- tooltip/truncated-help must be reachable & readable by screen readers

emma: Perfect. I'll update Figma with the UI and add copy strings. Can someone run the a11y audit once I post the branch?

jon: I'll run axe and keyboard tests on Thursday.

reza: I'll sanity-check backend payload and ensure filenames follow the pattern.

aria-bot: (reminder) Link to export docs: https://docs.redwood.ai/console/exports — include in the modal help.

emma: Thanks team — I'll ping when the prototype is up. :rocket:
